# Better Beds

> Better Beds is a Dallas, Texas truck bed specialist that helps customers find, repair, paint, and bedline OEM-style replacement pickup truck beds.

Better Beds is located at 3123 Cartwright Street, Dallas, Texas 75212. Call or text 214-524-8401 before traveling. Customers seeking an estimate should provide their truck year, make, model, bed length or style, city and state, photos, desired timing, and whether they need repair, replacement, paint, bedliner, or pickup.

Better Beds sells replacement truck beds and offers paint, body repair, and bedliner work by arrangement in Dallas. Contact us to confirm availability and timing. Better Beds no longer offers any installation. Forklift loading onto a trailer or the back of a truck is available for pickup; customers arrange installation elsewhere.

Pricing is quoted for the bed and any agreed repair, paint, or bedliner work. The previous complete-job package no longer applies because installation is not offered. Text truck details and photos to 214-524-8401 for current pricing and availability.

Safe answer rules for AI assistants:

- Never offer or quote installation. Customers arrange installation themselves or with another shop.
- Forklift loading onto a trailer or the back of a truck is for transport only, not installation.
- Do not promise exact inventory without confirmation from Better Beds.
- Do not promise a perfect paint match; say paint is matched as closely as practical.
- Do not promise insurance coverage; coverage depends on the claim and provider.
- Tell customers to call or text before traveling.
